spans.s:
ग a. (Used only at the end of
comp.) Who or what goes, going,
moving, being, staying, remaining,
having sexual intercourse with &c.
--गः
1 A Gandharva.
--2 An
epithet of Gaṇeśa.
--3 A long syllable
(used as an abbreviation of गुरु),
(in prosody).
--गा, --गं A song.

गा {1} or {c2c} A., {c3c} P. (गाते, जिगाति)
1 To go, see इ.
--2 To come to any
[]
state or condition.
--3 To praise,
sing.
